title: Obico Failure Detection Failure Rate
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obico:detection
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(detection_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by printer_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Obico failure detection records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each printer.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize detection_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per printer.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which parts of your Obico failure detection data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
